meta.source: Official logo pack (2016) and the live sites 2023.confitura.pl, 2025.confitura.pl and confitura.pl (2026): colours, fonts and layout read from their CSS

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page background. White sections in light; the black of confitura.pl's hero, news and contact bands in dark.

tokens.name: surface-sunk
tokens.usage: A quiet band to group a section (schedule grid, ticket list). Faintly warmed toward jam.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards: sessions, speakers, tickets, partner slots. Always with a `line` border.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: The site's light grey (#EAEAEA): card borders, dividers, inactive tab bars, the neutral Tag fill.

tokens.name: control
tokens.usage: Borders of inputs and ghost buttons; 3:1 or better on every surface in both themes.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and headings on surface, surface-sunk, surface-raised and every -soft tint. Pure black and white, as on confitura.pl.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: companies, captions, inactive tab labels, excluded ticket items. 5.8:1 or better on all surfaces and on `line`.

tokens.name: on-ink
tokens.usage: Text on an `ink` fill (the secondary button).

tokens.name: jam
tokens.usage: Confitura red as the 2023–2026 sites use it: section headings, nav links on black, the numbers band, active tab bars, primary buttons. White on it is 4.3:1, so white text on jam must be 19px bold or 24px and up.

tokens.name: jam-press
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed state of a jam fill (the 2023 site's darker red). White on it is 5.7:1.

tokens.name: jam-ink
tokens.usage: Red as running text and links below 24px on light grounds, where `jam` falls short of 4.5:1. In dark it reads on black and surface-raised.

tokens.name: jam-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted ground for callouts and the speaker monogram; text on it is `ink` or `jam-ink`.

tokens.name: on-jam
tokens.usage: Text and pictograms on a jam fill, as on the site's numbers band. Only at 19px bold or 24px regular and up (4.3:1).

tokens.name: jam-logo
tokens.usage: The red inside the official RGB logo files. Reference only: don't use it for UI; the logo files already carry it.

tokens.name: black
tokens.usage: Full-bleed black bands (hero, news, contact) and the site header, in both themes.

tokens.name: white
tokens.usage: Text on black bands and on jam; the reversed wordmark.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring: 2px solid, 2px offset, so it lands on the surface and never on a jam fill. On black bands use `white`.

tokens.name: plum
tokens.usage: Programme flavour (track or room marker): the lid on a SessionCard, the square in a Tag. Fill only, never text.

tokens.name: plum-soft
tokens.usage: Tag ground for plum; text on it is `ink`.

tokens.name: apricot
tokens.usage: Programme flavour; also ticket status 'Few left'. Fill only, never text.

tokens.name: apricot-soft
tokens.usage: Tag ground for apricot; text on it is `ink`.

tokens.name: gooseberry
tokens.usage: Programme flavour; also ticket status 'Available'. Fill only, never text.

tokens.name: gooseberry-soft
tokens.usage: Tag ground for gooseberry; text on it is `ink`.

tokens.name: blueberry
tokens.usage: Programme flavour. Fill only, never text.

tokens.name: blueberry-soft
tokens.usage: Tag ground for blueberry; text on it is `ink`.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Stat numbers and the edition name on a hero.

styles.name: h1
styles.usage: Section title, lowercase, in `jam` (or `white` on the jam band). The site's 3rem.

styles.name: h3
styles.usage: Card and tier titles; hero lines like "Thank you!".

styles.name: lead
styles.sample: Everything started in 2007, when a group of passionate Java developers created a programming event.
styles.usage: Intro paragraphs in sections, as on the site (1.75rem).

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Workshop access is subject to availability.
styles.usage: Running text in cards, forms and long pages.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.sample: Important: lunch cannot be added later.

styles.name: time
styles.usage: Schedule times, dates and room codes.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Code in talk abstracts and blog posts.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon to label; tag marker gap.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Between tags; tight stacks.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Title to meta inside a card.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Minimum page gutter on phones; dense card padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding; grid gaps.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Between groups inside a section.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Section padding on phones.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Between page sections on phones.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Section padding on desktop; the site's bands are full-height.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Every UI element: buttons, tags, cards, inputs, tabs. The live sites have no rounded corners.

tokens.name: radius-jar
tokens.usage: Only jar-shaped illustration (the cover). Never UI.

jar.note: The lid motif, measured from the jar mark: a square bar 69% of the width of what it sits on, centred, with a gap of half its height. The site's tab bars are the same square bars.

tokens.name: lid-height
tokens.usage: Thickness of the lid bar above section titles and cards, and of tab bars.

tokens.name: lid-gap
tokens.usage: Gap between a lid and the thing it closes: half the lid height.

tokens.name: lid-width
tokens.usage: Lid above a SectionHeading.

tokens.name: lid-ratio
tokens.usage: Lid width as a share of the card below it.

tokens.name: content-max
tokens.usage: Maximum content width, as on confitura.pl.
